name: BankC3_Entry0000
notes: Vector bytes (80 12, 4C 0557, CE DE C2, 4C 0077, 4C 01E4, 4C 0EFA) and targets checked; unpacked module JSLs $C3:000E at $7E:3D72; $C3:D16C/DE5C are 20 08 00 inside pal pack data.

name: C3_BootModule
notes: Exit 'X = C3_BootNmi's address' holds only without C3_BootIrqOn; with it (hook 11 passes $85) LDX #Scene_VIrqLine leaves X = $00D3. State both.

name: C3_BootIrq
notes: 'the module later installs its own' unsupported: only C3_BootModule writes IrqTrampoline; module sets NMITIMEN=$A1 (7E:3017), so this stays its IRQ. Fix text (and 'while unpacked').

name: C3_BootNmi
notes: RDNMI ack, INIDISP=$0F via long store, A low byte saved, P by RTI; C3_ModuleFrame later moves NmiTrampoline (C3_NmiBusy/C3_ModuleNmi), so 'while unpacked' holds.

name: Decomp_ToWram
notes: Format verified by my own Python (1313->$857F, all C2SceneRom packs). False: 'bank $00 acts as $7E and only low WRAM is reachable' - any Dest works, e.g. BootModule's $7E:3000. Drop it.

name: WinFx_BuildCircle
notes: 'last mirrored row and walk's top row are overwritten' is false for mode 1 with even r (rows Yc..Yc+r/2-1 kept) and odd tables (top row Yc-r kept); qualify both. Rest verified.

name: WinFx_Exit
notes: Sub-entry named in parent; REP #$30, PLY/PLX/PLA/PLP/PLD/PLB, RTL; stack matches both BuildCircle (mode PHA popped on all paths) and StepWipe pushes.

name: WinFx_FillEmpty
notes: Checked: entry at X, overlapping MVN Tmp+1 bytes X->X+2, bank by TableBank bit 0, DB after MVN, A=$FFFF, M/X/DP/DB. nit: radius-0 count $1C0 writes 3 bytes past a 224-line table.

name: WinFx_FillEmptyFrom
notes: Sub-entry named in FillEmpty header; X start, count in WinFx_Tmp; BuildCircle's 2($DF-row)-1 count empties rows through $DF exactly.

name: WinFx_StepWipe
notes: Checked fill ($E0 bytes, STA.l+MVN), frame count/stop, buffers by frame parity, runs 3-34/4-35, steps 8-11 / +1 in mode 2, clamps, TDC B=$03 quirk, stack. nit: 'end of the line array'

name: C3_RandomByte
notes: 'CMP's result is not used' is false: its carry (A vs the SLHV open-bus read) feeds ADC OPHCT. Also the final SBC OPVCT (2nd read: V high byte) is omitted from the list; add it.

name: C3_ScaleBitmap
notes: Clear is off by one: 16-bit STZ + MVN of A+1 bytes zero Dest..Dest+A+1, i.e. through old end (C=0) / old end+1 (C=1). Groups=4 not shown at $7E:520D (14-byte copy from $1400/$140E).

name: WinFx_BuildQuad
notes: 'the first one on a tie' is wrong: CMP/BCC switches when equal (C=1), so the last point with the smallest Y wins; fix the header. Fill counts, row 0/bottom/top MVNs, quirks, exit A=$0003 verified.

name: WinFx_QuadEdgeFlat
notes: Sub-entry code checked: Y = Y0*2 into [TablePtr],Y, two stores rows Y0/Y0+1, JMP QuadExit with M=1 (A=$0003 via TDC/XBA). Order claim is wrong in the parent header (see WinFx_QuadEdge).

name: WinFx_QuadEdge
notes: Flat edge: 'smaller X to row Y0' is false when |X0-X1| >= $80: CMP then BMI is a signed test, so the larger X goes first; state that quirk. DDA starts/carries, swap, DB, exit verified.

name: WinFx_QuadExit
notes: Sub-entry named in QuadEdge header: TDC/XBA gives A=$0003 (16-bit) with DP_WinFx, PLP/PLB/PLD, RTL; reached by fall-in, BRA and BuildQuad's/Flat's JMPs.

name: BankC3_EndMarker
notes: ROM bytes 'CODE END C3' at $10C0 after RTL ($6B at $10BF); $00 fill to $1200 checked. nit: that RTL is WinFx_QuadExit's (shared with BuildQuad).

name: C3_ModuleNmi
notes: Saves A/X/Y/D/B at 16 bits, JSL C3_ModuleFrame, JSR C3_SongCheck, RTI; trampoline-only entry checked (only C3_ModuleFrame writes $08B3; no module store to $0501).

name: C3_NmiBusy
notes: SEP/CMP.l RDNMI/RTI; P restored by RTI; trampoline-only claim checked ($08C9 hits in the module are CMP #$0008 operands).

name: C3_ModuleFrame
notes: Order of steps, DP=DB=0, CLI on bit 7, brightness/half-brightness paths, 32-byte MVN to $0950, Y=$0970; $7E:3013 JSL before NMITIMEN=$A1 traced in unpacked module.

name: C3_IrqAck
notes: SEP/CMP.l TIMEUP/RTI; no $45 $09 in kernel $C3:0000-$1312 or the unpacked module (own unpack, $857F bytes).

name: C3_MulSigned
notes: Magnitudes, partial products at +0/+1, sign from MulA hi EOR MulB, 32-bit negate checked; 8 module JSL sites match; DP hedged; DB must map CPU regs (abs WRMPY*).

name: C3_CopyFEto7E
notes: Bytes 54 7E FE: dest $7E, src $FE; A=$FFFF, DB=$7E after; module site $7E:36C5 passes [$F0]-1 (LDA $F0/DEC) as stated.

name: C3_CopyFEto7F
notes: Bytes 54 7F FE; module site $7E:36BC checked; $C3:17D2 lies inside the packed stream ($1313-$7A2B by own unpack).

name: C3_SongCheck
notes: Busy/EntryNoSong/Req!=Cur gates, Cur=Req, CmdId $10, Arg0=song, Arg1/2=$FFFF, Busy set around the JSL; DB=$00 from C3_ModuleFrame checked.

name: C3_CopyCodeOrder

name: C3_ReadPad
notes: HVBJOY wait, $3030 = L+R+Select+Start exact, reset path to $00:FF00, Start-edge toggle, $F2 / $4418+$0080 commands; module $7E:377A does LDX #$0400/DEX and SEP #$20 (REP at .done).

name: C3_RunScript
notes: Opcode 0 is not a sound: C3Mod_PlaySound ($7E:37F3) is LDX #0/JSR ($00F0,X), a call of module code at w (e.g. $7E:7EE8 resets the task lists). Say '0 call module routine w'; hedge Exit DP/DB/Y.

name: C3_TaskListRemove
notes: Unbounded CMP scan from $0920, STZ of the match, PLP; A=value, X=offset, Y kept; DB $7E from C3_RunScript maps low WRAM.
